name: Hydep Frame Sub-Assembly - Station-01
description: Built-in showcase demo based on the Hydep Op 30 workbook data.

steps.name: Pick & load Frame Base
steps.instruction: Pick & load Frame Base on Fixture with the help of Manipulator

steps.name: Scan QR Code
steps.instruction: Scan the QR Code with the help of the Hand Held Scanner

steps.name: Place Frame Gasket Cathode
steps.instruction: Pick the Frame Gasket Cathode from the Trolley and place it on the frame base

steps.name: Place manifold gasket
steps.instruction: Pick the manifold gasket from the Trolley and place it on the frame base

steps.name: Place Frame Cover
steps.instruction: Pick the Frame Cover from the trolley and place it on the frame base

steps.name: Move barcode to placard
steps.instruction: Remove the Bar Code from the Frame Cover and stick on the placard

extraCareAlerts: Make sure the calibration of the Fixture or Equipments is done before the start of every shift
Wear PPE while doing any operations ( Mandatory )
Enter the Part No. in SCADA if not scanned

processCharacteristics.parameter: Parts Should be free from dust, dirt and oil
Parts should be free from Dent and Damages

processCharacteristics.measurement: Gasket O to be at Top
processCharacteristics.technique: Data Capture OK/Not Ok against QR code

reactionPlan: Quarantine the assembly, inform shift incharge and supervisor immediately. Dis-assemble if necessary and check for faults / defects. All issues must be cleared within 2 hours.
